n_start: Hello, friends! Let's find out why we have day and night.
n_m1: First, let's say hello. Can you tap Mimi the cat?
n_m2: Now find Sam the bear. Tap Sam!
n_m3: Look at that big, bright Sun. Give it a tap!
n_m4: Mimi is getting sleepy. Turn the Earth, and take Mimi to the dark side.
n_m4ok: Shh. It's night time for Mimi. Good night, Mimi!
n_m5: Mimi is fast asleep. But who is awake now? Tap the friend who is awake!
n_m5ok: That's right! When it's night for Mimi, it's daytime for Sam.
n_m6: Time to wake up! Turn the Earth, and bring Mimi back to the sunshine.
n_m6ok: Good morning, Mimi! The Sun is shining on you again.
n_m7: Now look at Sam. What can Sam see in the sky? The Sun, or the Moon?
n_m7ok: Yes! Sam is on the dark side now, so Sam sees the Moon.
n_m8: Here's a tricky one. Which one was turning? The Sun, or the Earth?
n_m8ok: You got it! The Sun stays still. The Earth is the one that turns.
n_m9: Last one! Spin the Earth all the way around. One whole turn!
n_m9ok: Wow! One whole turn is one whole day.
n_fin: You did it! The Earth keeps turning, and that's why we have day and night. Great job, everyone!
n_hint5: Look for the friend with open eyes.
n_hint7: Hmm. Is Sam on the bright side, or the dark side?
n_hint8: Remember what the Sun told us!
n_play: Play time! Spin the Earth, and tap your friends.
a_hi: Hi! I'm Mimi! I live in Hong Kong.
b_hi: Hello! I'm Sam! I live far, far away.
s_hi: Hello! I'm the Sun! I stay right here, and I shine all day long.
s_2: I never move. The Earth does the turning!
m_hi: Hi! I'm the Moon. I go slowly around the Earth.
m_2: I shine at night, with light from the Sun.
